{{Quote|Best start using your eyes. If they've stolen anything valuable, it'll be your head.''"<br />"''Just shut up and fix me. Bottom-feeders will be sorry they ever stepped on Korriban.|Medic Orailus and Lieutenant Devron|<ref name="Imperial Edict">{{TORcite|type=general|Imperial Edict|Korriban}}</ref>}}
'''Devron''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. As part of [[Imperial Edict 936]], he was one of the [[Imperial soldier]]s assigned to eliminate [[Korriban tomb raiders|tomb raiders]] inside the [[Tomb of Ajunta Pall]] in the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. However, the raiders outmaneuvered Devron and his forces in the [[Burial/Legends|tomb]] using a passage unknown to the lieutenant, and the lieutenant was badly wounded in the fighting. After retreating from the tomb he was treated by [[Medic/Legends|Medic]] [[Orailus]] at a small medical station outside the tomb.

==Biography==
{{Quote|You're in bad shape, Lieutenant. A few grave robbers too much for you?''"<br />"''They're a special crew. Took some sort of secret passage into the tomb, around our defenses.|Orailus and Devron|<ref name="Imperial Edict" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Devron served in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a period of unrest between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TOR" /> Around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> he held the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] and was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. During his [[Time/Legends|time]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], Devron and other Imperial forces were assigned to eliminate a group of [[Korriban tomb raiders|tomb raiders]] in the [[Tomb of Ajunta Pall]],<ref name="TOR" /> as part of [[Imperial Edict 936]].<ref name="Imperial Edict" /> After the lieutenant and other Imperial forces has set up defenses inside the [[Burial/Legends|tomb]], the raiders used a passage that Devron was unaware of to circumvent the Imperial defenses.<ref name="TOR" /> During the fighting, many of the [[Imperial soldier]]s were [[Death/Legends|killed]]<ref name="Imperial Edict" /> and the lieutenant was badly wounded. Devron managed to retreat to a small medical station outside the tomb, where he was treated by [[Medic/Legends|Medic]] [[Orailus]]. While he was receving medical attention, Devron explained the situation to the medic, who warned the lieutenant that the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] would kill him if the raiders stole any valuable artifacts from the tomb.<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
After Devron's retreat, a [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolyte]] found a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] containing Imperial Edict 936 on one of the Imperial [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] killed inside of the tomb. The Acolyte managed to defeat a significant number of the tomb raiders and recovered several artifacts stolen by them.<ref name="Imperial Edict" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|The Sith want them cleared out, but&hellip; too many places for them to hide in there. Underworld scum.|Devron speaking about the tomb robbers on Korriban|<ref name="Imperial Edict" />}}
When Lieutenant Devron was outsmarted and badly wounded by the tomb raiders, he attempted to explain it by saying that the group was a special crew and that they found a secret passage. While he made threats towards the tomb raiders while at the medical station, he was reluctant to make another attempt to clear out the raiders, as the tomb offered them a multitude of hiding places. During his conversation with Orailus, he snapped at the medic and referred to the looters using derogatory terms. Devron had fair skin, [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and wore his dark brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]] in a striped pattern.<ref name="TOR" />

==Equipment==
While at the medical station, Devron carried a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] and wore the same red and gray [[Sith trooper armor/Legends|armor]] worn by other Imperial troopers stationed on Korriban at that time.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lieutenant Devron appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] produced by [[BioWare]]. In the game, Devron is a character in the Valley of the Dark Lords on the planet Korriban, the starting area for players that choose the Sith Inquisitor or Sith Warrior class. In the game, Devron and a medic named Orailus have a conversation about tomb robbers, which the player can observe and hear, but not be a part of. The conversation relates to<ref name="TOR" /> the quest "Imperial Edict," where the player finds a mission briefing about eliminating the tomb raiders and recovering stolen artifacts.<ref name="Imperial Edict" />
